effect.name: Deltarune Vessel Background (Switch)
effect.description: This shader recreates the background effect used in the creation of Vessel in DELTARUNE (Chapter 1) created by Toby Fox.
effect.author: Foxioo (Recreation of an effect from a DELTARUNE created by Toby Fox)

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Deltarune Vessel Background (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.20 */
parameter.description: This shader recreates the background effect used in the creation of Vessel in DELTARUNE (Chapter 1) created by Toby Fox.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable manages which color will be reduced. Set to 0 is the blend color will be reduced and set to 1 is the base color will be reduced.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Point X
parameter.description: A variable that determines point position in the X axis.

parameter.name: Point Y
parameter.description: A variable that determines point position in the Y axis.

parameter.name: Offset
parameter.description: This variable determines the amount of scale shift; the closer it is to 0, the smaller the texture approximation.

parameter.name: Time
parameter.description: This variable defines the positions of the looped effect.

parameter.name: Quality
parameter.description: This variable determines the quality; the higher the value, the more work the GPU does.
